summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing summarized consolidated financial information for the period ended September 30, 2026. The report shows total assets of MCh$78,140,567, net interest income of MCh$1,618,934, net fee and commission income of MCh$426,775, a loan-loss provision of MCh$442,631, and consolidated net income of MCh$916,317, of which MCh$892,843 is attributable to equity holders. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report, not a special situation warranting a deal-risk arbitrage angle.
